thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx spike detected in northeast-edge egress cluster. 5xx rate -> 18% over last 2m (baseline ~0.3%). Affected path: /v1/generate -> gateway-proxy -> edge-egress. Trigger: error-rate-alerts#northeast. Paging oncall.

alice_w (oncall): on it, looking at dashboards now. cc @carla_sre in case this is infra related.

carla_sre: seeing an increase in upstream 502/504 from edge-egress nodes. CPU/mem look fine. Latency for proxy->egress jumps around 50-200ms. Repro rate matches many customers. :rotating_light:

ben_ops: are we seeing any autoscale activity or throttles? checking k8s events and node pools.

dave_infra: quick check: we had a failed rolling restart batch 25m ago in northeast due to kubelet transient error — but then finished. Could be leftover conn-state. Pulling connection metrics and proxy error logs.

eve_support: we already have two customers reporting increased 5xx in the region via support tickets. Flagging potential customer-impact -> HIGH for sessions originating in us-northeast-2.

carla_sre: extracting logs from a single problematic proxy: ```
2026-03-10T16:01:05Z proxy[edge-egress-7]: upstream read: connection reset by peer
2026-03-10T16:01:06Z proxy[edge-egress-7]: 502 GET /v1/generate 0.42s
2026-03-10T16:01:06Z proxy[edge-egress-7]: kvcache miss, fallback to model-serve-2
```

ben_ops: k8s events show intermittent pod DNS resolution failures around the same window. Possibly a CNI flake on subset of nodes. I'm seeing flaps on calico for 3 nodes.

frank_prod: impact: several customer-facing endpoints degraded. Estimated requests affected ~12% of regional traffic, error responses are mostly 502/504. No data leakage reported. Customers: alpha-inc, beta-app have tickets.

alice_w (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas:
- start routing ~30% traffic away from northeast to central as a controlled failover
- spin up replacement egress pool in central region with warmed models
- enable short-circuit fallback to model-serve-mirrors to avoid upstream connection churn

carla_sre: agree. I'll coordinate failover config. Plan: update routing weight via traffic-router service to shift 30% -> central for 10m, monitor error-rate and p99.

ben_ops: prepping command to update weights. will run after approvals. ```sh
# set 30% to central, 70% keep in northeast
curl -X POST "https://traffic-router/api/v1/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"region_weights": {"us-northeast-2": 0.7, "us-central-1": 0.3}}'
```

dave_infra: before we do that, note: central currently has 60% spare capacity, but model-warm start latency ~400ms for large models. We should warm key models first. I'll trigger warmup jobs.

deploy-bot: deploy starting: warmup-job/model-warmers:v3 -> 6 replicas

deploy-bot: warmup-job/model-warmers:v3 completed successfully on central (6/6)

carla_sre: ok warming done. I'm going to shift 30% now. Running Ben's command.

ben_ops: ran traffic-router change, returned 200. New weights applied.

alice_w (oncall): monitoring... error-rate in northeast dropped from 18% -> 6% within 90s. Total regional errors decreased ~55%. p95 latency stable. :thumbsup:

eve_support: updating customers: posting a short message to affected customers acknowledging elevated errors and that we are shifting traffic to mitigate. Draft: "We're currently experiencing elevated API errors in the us-northeast-2 region. We've routed a portion of traffic to a healthy region to reduce impact. We're continuing to monitor and will update shortly." Thoughts?

frank_prod: good. Add note: "No data loss. Some requests may see higher latency." Also include troubleshooting ticket ID.

carla_sre: follow-up: logs indicate repeated connection reset from egress-backend instances associated with a single ASG subset. I'm seeing TCP RSTs from host-level NAT gateway occasionally. I'll open a cloud provider ticket. Suspect egress firewall/NAT gateway saturation.

ben_ops: opened ticket with provider (case# 987654). They replied: "We see transient SNAT exhaustion on a NAT gateway cluster between 15:50-16:10 UTC. Recommending using multiple NAT gateways and/or increase ephemeral port pool."

alice_w (oncall): good find. Short-term we already mitigated via reroute. Medium-term: schedule change to add additional NAT gw and increase SNAT pool. Add to infra backlog and mark P1 follow-up.

carla_sre: creating an incident doc now. Will include timeline, mitigation steps, affected customers, and action items.

alice_w (oncall): handing off to next on-call in 30m. @carla_sre will remain on standby for provider comms. Next oncall: @ben_ops.

ben_ops: acknowledged, taking handoff. Monitoring through next hour. I'll escalate back if error rate rises >5% regionally or customer tickets cross threshold.

eve_support: keeping ticket owners updated. Slack updates -> posting to #statuspage-drafts for review.

frank_prod: summary for postmortem: cause: SNAT exhaustion on provider-managed NAT gateway causing upstream resets -> cascading 5xx. Mitigation: traffic reroute, warm model pool, provider ticket. Action items: add config to traffic-router for automated region spillover, increase NAT redundancy, add SNAT monitoring alert, update runbook to include warmup step before traffic shift.

carla_sre: incident doc link: https://redwood-internal/infra/incidents/1918765432-northeast-egress-snat-exhaustion (draft)

alice_w (oncall): final note before handoff: everyone please react with :white_check_mark: when you've read the incident doc. I'll drop a short blurb to execs after Ben confirms stability.

ben_ops: :white_check_mark:

carla_sre: :white_check_mark: will own follow-ups.

eve_support: :white_check_mark: updating customer comms channel.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). Alert auto-suppressed. Please update incident doc with timeline and assign action owners.

ben_ops: leaving monitoring on. If any regression, paging rules re-enabled. Thanks all for quick turnaround.

alice_w (oncall): handing off officially to @ben_ops. Oncall shift ends in 28m.

ben_ops: taking over. ping me if anything blips. closing thread for active coordination - will reopen if needed.
